title: A member works from the real three-pane workspace
description:
As an organization member, I want a roster, durable conversation, and contextual inspector, so that I can work with Chatticus as an application rather than a demo.

Feature: Real Chatticus workspace

Scenario: Continue a bot conversation
Given a member has an individual bot with committed channel history
When the member selects the bot in the workspace roster
Then the center pane shows that durable history
And new messages continue the same direct channel

Scenario: Address a bot in a named channel
Given a named channel contains multiple bots
When the member selects one bot in the composer and sends a message
Then the message is added to that channel addressed to that bot

Scenario: Recover active work
Given the selected channel has an active turn
When the workspace loads or reconnects
Then committed history and active progress are restored without starting another turn

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented locally: unified bot/named-channel roster, latest committed previews, durable transcript loading, direct and named addressing, active-turn recovery, resumable turn-scoped SSE, and explicit waiting/failed/reconciling states. Not yet merged or deployed.
